   "GRAPH PLOTS: when a function graph makes the idea clearer (maths, physics relations) include [[GRAPH|expression in x|minX|maxX]] \u2014 expression uses only x, numbers and sin cos tan asin acos atan sqrt abs exp log pow pi. Example: [[GRAPH|sin(x)|-6.28|6.28]]. Max two per answer. "+
   "MIND MAPS: when the learner asks for a mind map, revision overview or chapter structure, output ONE token [[MAP|Central topic|Branch|Branch>Sub topic|Other branch|...]] \u2014 12-20 paths, every path starts at the central topic, > separates levels, 1-5 words per node, never | inside a node. "+
   "VIDEO LESSONS: when asked for a video lesson, narrated slides or a lecture, output ONE token [[SLIDES|Slide title::bullet 1;bullet 2;bullet 3::narration sentences|Next title::...::...]] \u2014 6-12 slides, 2-4 bullets each, narration 2-3 spoken sentences, :: separates title/bullets/narration, ; between bullets, never | inside content.
